sources.snippet: When scaling to VOSR-1.4B, we adopt the 16-channel Qwen-Image VAE to better preserve input fidelity. Although Qwen-Image is designed for T2I generation, it is released in a video-VAE form, which is unnecessarily slow for image SR inference.

sources.title: VOSR: A Vision-Only Generative Model for Image Super-Resolution
sources.snippet: We therefore first train a multi-step VOSR model and then distill it into a one-step variant for fast deployment. Fig. 1 compares VOSR with generative SR methods in terms of performance, efficiency, and training cost across both T2I-based and vision-only approaches under multi-step and one-step settings.

sources.title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: A central challenge is to transfer the reward-aligned parsing behavior learned by the 4B RL model into a compact 0.8B model suitable for deployment. The 4B branch has greater capacity and can absorb reward signals more stably, while the compact branch is more sensitive to high-variance updates on long structured outputs.
